name: recharts
description_en: Redefined chart library built with React and D3
readme_excerpt: Recharts Introduction Recharts is a Redefined chart library built with React and D3. The main purpose of this library is to help you to write charts in React applications without any pain. Main principles of Recharts are: 1. Simply deploy with React components. 2. Native SVG support, lightweight with minimal dependencies. 3. Declarative components. Documentation at recharts.github.io and our storybook Also see the wiki.
